title: StackOps MCP Catalog
description: Named MCP servers that StackOps can install into agent configurations. Each server uses either a local command or an HTTP URL.

$schema.description: Path or URL of the JSON Schema used for editor completion, help, and validation.

mcpServers.description: Server definitions keyed by the names used to select them in MCP commands.

stdioServer.description: A local MCP process communicating through standard input and output. Requires command; HTTP url and headers are not allowed.

command.description: Executable used to start the MCP server. Put command arguments in args. Supports {home} for the user's home directory.

args.description: Arguments passed to the executable in order. Each string is one argument and supports {home}.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the server, keyed by variable name. Values must be strings and support {home}.

cwd.description: Working directory for the MCP server process. Supports {home} for the user's home directory.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the server and the tools it provides.

enabled.description: Whether the server is enabled in the generated agent configuration. Defaults to true when omitted.

httpServer.description: An MCP server accessed over HTTP. Requires url; local command, args, env, and cwd are not allowed.

url.description: HTTP endpoint of the MCP server. Supports {home} replacement.

headers.description: HTTP request headers, such as Authorization, keyed by header name. Values must be strings and support {home}.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the server and the tools it provides.

enabled.description: Whether the server is enabled in the generated agent configuration. Defaults to true when omitted.

serverDefinition.description: Define command for a local stdio server or url for an HTTP server, but not both.
